description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Rules of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka New Pension Scheme.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the rescission of pension rules for the Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka under the Central Bank of Sri Lanka Act, No. 16 of 2023. It involves legal/regulatory matters - specifically the modification of statutory rules and regulations governing pension benefits. While it mentions the Governor (Dr. P. Nandalal Weerasinghe), this is in the context of his authority to issue the rules rather than a personnel appointment or change. The core content is about legal provisions, rule-making authority, and regulatory changes, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
